content: पीठम् .²1 A seat (a stool, chair, bench, sofa <ab>&c.</ab>); जवेन पीठादुदतिष्ठदच्युतः <ls>Śi. 1. 12</ls>; <ls>R. 4. 84</ls>, <ls n="R.">6. 15</ls>. .²2 The seat of a religious student made of Kuśa grass. .²3 The seat of a deity, an altar. .²4 A pedestal in general, basis. .²5 A particular posture in sitting. .²6 (In geometry) The complement of a segment. .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of various temples; पीठं जालंधरं नाम तिष्ठत्यत्र चतुर्मुख <ls>Yogaśikhopaniṣad 5. 11</ls>. .²8 A royal seat, throne. .²9 A district, province.
